intervals: Descriptive 95% normal intervals for independent paired hands; subgroups not simultaneous; no adaptive sampling or strict precision gate
policyLimit: Reuse prior finite heuristic private opportunity fit; NOT retrained to equilibrium or assumed optimal
noRollBaseline: Act normally now; preserve future paid Roll opportunities
note: Forced random Roll may have negative EV. Voluntary finite-policy results and loss risk are reported separately. Positive point estimates do not prove every state profitable.
